changeSet.author: nexus-em75s.2
changeSet.comment: nexus.tuples: the Linda tuple space (RDR-205 Technical Design). Tenant-scoped: RLS ENABLE+FORCE with the tenant_isolation policy shape from catalog-036-embedding-profile.xml's changeset catalog-036-3. id is a caller-computed sha256 (see file header); this changeset does not derive it. autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor=0.01: first per-table storage parameter in this changelog, set here because of this table's claim/ack/nack/expire churn rate relative to size.

changeSet.author: nexus-em75s.2
changeSet.comment: nexus.tuple_claim_log: append-only claim|ack|nack|expire|dead audit trail (RDR-205 Technical Design). subspace/template denormalised so a row reads standalone even after its tuple is purged (May's nexus-pce1.4 fix). tuple_id FK to nexus.tuples(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, indexed — the purge deletes through it (see file header). Tenant-scoped: RLS ENABLE+FORCE with its own tenant_isolation policy, same shape as every audit table here. autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor=0.01, same rationale as tuples-001-1.

changeSet.author: nexus-em75s.2
changeSet.comment: nexus.tuple_tenants: sweep-cursor bookkeeping (RDR-205 Technical Design). No tenant_id, no RLS — same posture as service_tokens/install_pings/embedding_models (telemetry-014-install-pings.xml's file header, catalog-036-1's comment): this table names tenants and holds no tenant-owned data of its own, and the sweep that reads it needs to see every tenant's row, not one tenant's slice.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE nexus.tuple_tenants ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, first_seen TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, last_seen TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, last_swept_at TIMESTAMPTZ, CONSTRAINT tuple_tenants_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id) );
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS nexus.tuple_tenants CASCADE
